name: madecassic acid
summary: Pentacyclic triterpenoid from Centella asiatica that promotes collagen synthesis and skin barrier repair. Works synergistically with asiaticoside. Used in skincare; oral bioavailability being studied.
description: Madecassic acid from Centella is framed around matrix remodeling and cytoprotective survival signaling relevant to tissue repair responses.
safetyNotes: Mostly preclinical or extract-derived; concentrated doses may affect glucose, lipids, liver enzymes, or bleeding risk depending matrix.
dosage: standardized extract or essential-oil-free preparation when oral use is intended
typical_dosage: standardized extract or essential-oil-free preparation when oral use is intended
evidence_grade_explanation: Both evidence signals agree on limited evidence.
evidence_rationale: No study design has been recorded for this profile yet.
